body:
# T16 — Benefits (retrospective, 2026-11-23)

## Goals and outcomes

- G1 — Procedure knowledge is ingested as typed drafts, not free text.
- G2 — Nothing publishes without a human decision.
- G3 — One model: knowledge packs are referenced by `knowledge_pack_ref`.

## Measures

- **B7 — tokens per demo-credited deliverable:** baseline 630,565 → target 504,452 (20% reduction).
  T16 contributes six demo-credited deliverables to the denominator.
- **Publication assurance:** zero unreviewed sources bound; proved by
  `an_unreviewed_source_cannot_bind`.
- **Acceptance:** 25/25 tests at the lane head, with the clause-to-test map in the acceptance
  evidence document.

## Benefits and sub-benefits

- **Efficiency (B7)** ← six accepted deliverables, each demo-credited.
- **Assurance** ← the human publication gate; the drafting job cannot publish its own procedure.
- **Reuse (B5)** ← the OWL knowledge pack is bound by reference, so one model serves many procedures.
- **Operability** ← a bound job runs the PDDL steps of a reviewed procedure.
title: T16 — Benefits (retrospective, 2026-11-23)
